efficacy_outcome: Semaglutide increased NASH resolution (OR 3.18, 95% CI 1.70–5.95; P<0.001); fibrosis stage did not significantly improve (OR 0.71, 95% CI 0.15–3.41; P=0.67).
safety_signal: GI-related side effects were more frequent with semaglutide (OR 3.72, 95% CI 1.68–8.23; P=0.001); serious adverse events were similar to placebo (OR 1.40, 95% CI 0.75–2.62).
